paragraphs.text: Dean Shaile Talonrook is an owlin cleric and former dean of the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . She was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

Dean Shaile used to be a perennially optimistic owlin with a powerful, dramatic speaking voice. She was a master of literature and often quoted obscure passages from famous texts. Her soul-filling advice and educated references had been known to make people glow.

Shaile believed that people were generally good and wished to teach her students how to make the world a better place. She and Dean Embrose often clashed over Silverquill's curriculum, but the balance found between them is far more eloquent than even their words can describe.

After being compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion , Shaile's tongue and beak were replaced by a spreading web of metal filaments. She attacked the remaining students but was thwarted by Embrose Lu .
